Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.if: pipeline trigger conditions (on a pull request Drone matches the branch filter against the target branch, so the condition leaves pull requests out, as a branch test of a GitLab merge request pipeline does)
